products.name: MSI Infinite ZS
products.summary: Gaming desktop with AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D, GeForce RTX 5090 32 GB and a 1300 W PSU.
products.description: The Infinite ZS 9NVZ-2261US pairs an AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D (360 mm liquid cooler) with a GeForce RTX 5090 32 GB GDDR7. It ships with 32 GB DDR5, a 2 TB M.2 NVMe SSD, 2.5 GbE, Wi-Fi 7 and a 1300 W power supply.

products.name: Acer Predator Orion 6000 (PO6-605)
products.summary: Gaming desktop with Intel Core Ultra 9 285K, GeForce RTX 5080 and an 850 W 80 Plus Gold PSU.
products.description: The Predator Orion 6000 PO6-605-UR18W pairs an Intel Core Ultra 9 285K (up to 5.7 GHz) with an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080. It ships with 32 GB DDR5, a 1 TB M.2 PCIe Gen4 SSD, Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 5.4 and an 850 W 80 Plus Gold power supply in a white chassis.
